method: Static local review of exactly two Python sources and manifest; no network, execution, tests, deserialization or large-payload hashing performed by reviewer.
checks: Exact caller-supplied manifest digest checked before JSON use; fixed own repository/revision and finite ten-file budget checked.
Fresh destination uses exist_ok=False. Partial creation uses xb; final os.link fails if final path already exists. Existing target is not overwritten.
Streaming consumes at most expected size plus one byte; exact total bytes and SHA256 checked before publishing each final file.
Existing credential is read from the standard token file into memory; no copy or log is emitted. Redirect handler strips Authorization on every redirect and permits only HTTPS without URL userinfo.
Failure output includes exception class and optional HTTP status only; exception text, signed URLs and credentials are not printed.
Imports and operations are stdlib only; no model/data deserialization, fitting, prediction or grading.
Offline tests cover final create-only behavior, short/long/wrong-hash streams, path traversal and redirect auth/plaintext boundary; reviewer inspected but did not rerun.
nonblocking_operational_limits: Runtime must provide Python 3.11+ (datetime.UTC and hashlib.file_digest).
CPU/memory/global-wall limits are supplied by the external launcher, not enforced by this script. The script supplies 25-second per-request timeout only; a wall-time kill can leave partial files.
Failure retains already validated files and any partial. No success receipt is emitted until all ten files complete. Retry requires a fresh destination because destination creation is exclusive.

This scoped review assumes trusted existing destination parents and no concurrent hostile local replacement. The script does not independently reject ancestor symlinks or defend mkdir/open races; exact manifest paths contain no traversal.

The final receipt is create-only but not atomically published or fsynced as a directory transaction; after interruption parseability and presence of every verified final file must be checked before downstream use.
not_authorized_by_review: No execution performed; no general-purpose downloader approval; changes to source/manifest invalidate the recorded source identity.
